# RELEASE


## DETAILS


## Canton Now a ‘Gig-Ready’ Community


August 31, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.uniti.com/node/16721/pdf)


- *In celebration of this milestone, Kinetic hosts free festivities Aug. 31 – Sept. 5*
- *More than 75% of homes have access to Multi-Gig, Next-Generation internet*
- *Kinetic reaches milestone of 30,000+ fiber locations in the community*


CANTON, Ga., Aug. 31, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kinetic, the leading residential and business insurgent fiber internet provider, announced today that Canton is officially recognized as a Kinetic[“Gig-Ready Community](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=BZnNO1eECxXdabmMrLtx08kPiD1ARIc283qVNi-lUtwbJJhTVh3d9e7GL85N3iwT5kG-RLrJQyKCPCj8W1WLx8Bk_wogmX2RZ-MCS3nPMWa2GdTHGhJsuRMAqNIQTKdFyMNlPjMPt-pnSGG010SxiutSjwmA0yV3xOvGc87DQlawwiLymmNjdpf9BXj0g6XzftQtUi4B0VLQmN3dnytJaiGUHB3MmW3K6M7z1IZyi8JL6VogYWYtZ7ATuznIicySKBGiU3rL5sAyEvj6MUgJTLX3BepXVNI67k8qkLqGABj0pmePS7CIdInodgpzQ66WsgLNoVeG6Hrl2I5uGc89Hv91PpOTY152pqXY1yTWtkkmSe-dMUani7o0-LH10GeQ_-_Yv7qeLgy8t0HDuDnHFVCCQrE0srv6BQkPEVaugXE=) ,” meaning more than 75% of the homes in the community now have access to Kinetic’s high-speed, next generation internet.


Additionally, Kinetic passed another significant milestone in community today by installing more than 30,000 new fiber locations in the community.


These major technological milestones mark a significant advancement in the community’s digital infrastructure, allowing for a better internet experience, at a better value, for more residents.


“Canton is an important community for Kinetic and a key part of the region’s growing technology corridor,” said Stacy Hale, Kinetic’s state operations president. “In honor of surpassing this milestone, it’s time that we celebrate. And to the residents of this area, know that we’re not done yet; we’ll continue adding more fiber locations and will remain a long-term partner to this community. Canton is a city of the future; fiber, will help it get there faster.”


***Fast Forward: Canton*** **— a Free Community Celebration**
To celebrate these milestones, Kinetic will host fun, free events with the community. Events include philanthropic activities where Kinetic employees spend time giving back to those in need, provide free treats and vouchers from local restaurants, host family-friendly neighborhood events, and a free community Hollywood Movie Night: *Lights, Fiber, Action* .


**Planned week highlights**


- **Wednesday, Sept. 2:** Kinetic will host a free technology, internet and security course from 11 a.m. to noon at the Canton Senior Center.
- **Thursday, Sept. 3:** Kinetic will host Hollywood Movie Night: *Lights, Fiber, Action* at the Canton Theater. Come see a special screening of *Inside Out 2* . Doors open at 5:30 p.m.; movie starts at 7 p.m. RSVP[here](https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/04638714b5284e6791b42a2a2d45b66e) . Limited seating, while supplies last.
- **Friday, Sept. 4:**


- Fiber Night Lights: Kinetic will give away swag items at the Sequoyah High School football game starting at 6:30 p.m.
- Kinetic will have a booth at First Friday in Downtown Canton from 6 – 9 p.m. Attendees can paint a section of a “community canvas” and enter for a chance to win a YETI cooler.


**Why Canton’s infrastructure matters**
Fiber is the best technology for the long-term success of Canton’s communications needs.[Research](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ScuIqhRX-jCKJmQI4_pnD--UvFl9JRxXdZMt23yJL1JuudqJs67SAR-uOe6Qvtw-wiwk1xTlRUgdRGgvA2QWar5rx1cjdWqEBNg2s-4-hHlckaWhPQBm8TdDQqCLdA2vFx6On16Vcs-6q38kKJwZcxAQ98ZjHs-OKOCJbp99cZL2kcI-1wfm4p7TNeI0TMKmY3fA9FruyCx0InaqWnViyQ==) shows that fiber-connected communities experience 213% higher business growth, 10% higher self-employment and a[14-17%](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=MiN0AN8bNWmb_osavUo0IaM73VtwNFOmKPfuWPudPWhRowkeD6x7FLPGdbk8Ac5SNEtRkpg3n0vXsz0LVZhjqj1E6FDWsvqUsq2NiC6eQeDBUVumMU9-tUxIFh-zbCoTs4iJkIYbgB4kYxDmpjxMgw==) increase in home values. Fiber is also significantly more sustainable and uses up to 95% less energy per gigabit. It requires less maintenance over time, which reduces environmental impact and community disruption.


As a long-term partner to the Canton community, Kinetic is committed to delivering on its promise to provide fast, reliable, future-proof connectivity that helps local economic growth, education, telehealth, and small business competitiveness. This investment underscores the company’s dedication to providing the communities it serves—the same communities its employees also live and work in—with sustained value both now and for years to come.


Kinetic, which was also named CNET’s Best Rural Fiber Internet Provider in 2026, is proud to serve the community beyond internet connectivity. Kinetic’s fiber expansion milestone in Canton follows the company recently reaching 2 million homes passed with fiber internet across its 18-state footprint.


Residents who want to check fiber availability or construction updates can call 1- 877-90-FIBER (877-903-4237) or visit[www.gokinetic.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=200mbkDzd_FrQaXi5d8PWuzrpmmM5Joml6wywqCsbX7SJ8zkHPbP6z0h4wcf0qMWjkvLaSIWjzETSD0hKsSkPPCcm5QyJQ7IBVxvKLnf4Iy45aNTH6MgLxo8c_cp_-zEObkDnd6PPs2UCJ_RCAdhY9QvIUirYLa-iFxaB8AHAnpWci3lphljXlsElSnJfflG5gNSS97Gq2LcUEE3KLzASe_Ss0u_r4mQfYgaer1nrhM=) .


**About Kinetic:** Named the 2026 Telecommunications Company of the Year (Stevie GOLD/American Business Awards), Kinetic is a business unit of Uniti (NASDAQ: UNIT), and is a premier insurgent provider of multi-gigabit fiber internet, whole-home Wi-Fi, internet security, and voice services in 1,400 markets across 18 states in the Southwestern, Southeastern, Midwestern, and Northeastern U.S. Additional information is available at gokinetic.com.
